ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, and identify any other entities or individuals who may be involved
questions: How did the suspects launder the stolen money?
Are there any other entities or individuals involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will be key to understanding the full extent of the scheme, and identifying any other entities or individuals who may be involved. I would start by analyzing financial records and looking for any suspicious transactions.
